main_text.p: Weltero, Maximo : nos meest] Nos Angli most : Sax. mærta ?
Wiedon,Mercis] Merces Sax.meoe, nobis meed. Eis etiam Munera(bzlbes) meaorceaττaɾ ?

Wiuel, Magnus, Multa, Copiosa : & mikilon,magnis : & mikilo magnificè : & oimikilt, magnificate. vide Wimf-kiloda : & mikle,magnificentia] Multús Saxon.mycel, hactenus in partibus Angliæ Borealibus retentum. Multitudo, mycelnerre; magnificare autem, zemiclian; magnificentia, myclunz, & mycelnyr ?
Wuodis, Mentis : nos, moezt] Vide supra Wefmodl.
Wuos, Esca, cibi. Nos pro Olere] Huic,sono saltem,affine; Sax. myre,& mere,pro Mensa : iis etiam mete pro cibo : nobis hodie mette pro ferculo.
main_text.head: Verba.
main_text.p: Wendlan sal, Exsultabo : mendita, exsultabit : mendit, exsultate : mendo-dun, exsultaverunt : mendon salon, exsultabunt.

page.notes: Several words are in Anglo-Saxon and partly illegible; the Greek-looking glyphs are Anglo-Saxon (Old English) characters rendered approximately. Handwritten marks at the right margin (237) and stains are not transcribed. Hh is the gathering signature.
